mapper.sql: SELECT INCOME_STATEMENT_ID, STATEMENT_ID, ENTERPRISE_ID, ENTERPRISE_NAME, REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, REPORT_DATE, DATA_STATUS, DATA_SOURCE, OPERATING_REVENUE, MAIN_BUSINESS_REVENUE, OTHER_BUSINESS_REVENUE, INVESTMENT_INCOME, FAIR_VALUE_CHANGE_INCOME, ASSET_DISPOSAL_INCOME, OTHER_INCOME, NON_OPERATING_INCOME, OPERATING_COST, MAIN_BUSINESS_COST, OTHER_BUSINESS_COST, SELLING_EXPENSES, ADMINISTRATIVE_EXPENSES, RD_EXPENSES, FINANCIAL_EXPENSES, ASSET_IMPAIRMENT_LOSS, CREDIT_IMPAIRMENT_LOSS, NON_OPERATING_EXPENSES, GROSS_PROFIT, OPERATING_PROFIT, TOTAL_PROFIT, INCOME_TAX_EXPENSE, NET_PROFIT, NET_PROFIT_ATTRIBUTABLE_TO_PARENT, MINORITY_PROFIT_LOSS, OTHER_COMPREHENSIVE_INCOME, COMPREHENSIVE_INCOME_TOTAL, COMPREHENSIVE_INCOME_ATTRIBUTABLE_TO_PARENT, COMPREHENSIVE_INCOME_ATTRIBUTABLE_TO_MINORITY, BASIC_EARNINGS_PER_SHARE, DILUTED_EARNINGS_PER_SHARE, GROSS_PROFIT_MARGIN, OPERATING_PROFIT_MARGIN, NET_PROFIT_MARGIN, PERIOD_EXPENSE_RATIO, RD_EXPENSE_RATIO, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, DELETED, VERSION FROM INCOME_STATEMENT_DATA
mapper.select: SELECT REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, OPERATING_REVENUE, GROSS_PROFIT, OPERATING_PROFIT, NET_PROFIT, GROSS_PROFIT_MARGIN, OPERATING_PROFIT_MARGIN, NET_PROFIT_MARGIN, CASE WHEN NET_PROFIT_MARGIN >= 15 THEN 'EXCELLENT' WHEN NET_PROFIT_MARGIN >= 10 THEN 'GOOD' WHEN NET_PROFIT_MARGIN >= 5 THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE 'POOR' END as profitabilityLevel FROM INCOME_STATEMENT_DATA WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD

SELECT REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, OPERATING_REVENUE, MAIN_BUSINESS_REVENUE, OTHER_BUSINESS_REVENUE, INVESTMENT_INCOME, OTHER_INCOME, ROUND(MAIN_BUSINESS_REVENUE / OPERATING_REVENUE * 100, 2) as mainBusinessRevenueRatio, ROUND(OTHER_BUSINESS_REVENUE / OPERATING_REVENUE * 100, 2) as otherBusinessRevenueRatio, ROUND(INVESTMENT_INCOME / OPERATING_REVENUE * 100, 2) as investmentIncomeRatio FROM INCOME_STATEMENT_DATA WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND OPERATING_REVENUE > 0 AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD

SELECT REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, OPERATING_REVENUE, OPERATING_COST, MAIN_BUSINESS_COST, OTHER_BUSINESS_COST, ROUND(OPERATING_COST / OPERATING_REVENUE * 100, 2) as operatingCostRatio, ROUND(MAIN_BUSINESS_COST / OPERATING_REVENUE * 100, 2) as mainBusinessCostRatio, ROUND(OTHER_BUSINESS_COST / OPERATING_REVENUE * 100, 2) as otherBusinessCostRatio FROM INCOME_STATEMENT_DATA WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND OPERATING_REVENUE > 0 AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD

SELECT REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, OPERATING_REVENUE, SELLING_EXPENSES, ADMINISTRATIVE_EXPENSES, RD_EXPENSES, FINANCIAL_EXPENSES, (SELLING_EXPENSES + ADMINISTRATIVE_EXPENSES + RD_EXPENSES + FINANCIAL_EXPENSES) as totalPeriodExpenses, ROUND(SELLING_EXPENSES / OPERATING_REVENUE * 100, 2) as sellingExpenseRatio, ROUND(ADMINISTRATIVE_EXPENSES / OPERATING_REVENUE * 100, 2) as administrativeExpenseRatio, ROUND(RD_EXPENSES / OPERATING_REVENUE * 100, 2) as rdExpenseRatio, ROUND(FINANCIAL_EXPENSES / OPERATING_REVENUE * 100, 2) as financialExpenseRatio, PERIOD_EXPENSE_RATIO FROM INCOME_STATEMENT_DATA WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND OPERATING_REVENUE > 0 AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD

SELECT REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, OPERATING_REVENUE, LAG(OPERATING_REVENUE) OVER (ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD) as prevOperatingRevenue, CASE WHEN LAG(OPERATING_REVENUE) OVER (ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD) > 0 THEN ROUND((OPERATING_REVENUE - LAG(OPERATING_REVENUE) OVER (ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD)) / LAG(OPERATING_REVENUE) OVER (ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD) * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END as revenueGrowthRate FROM INCOME_STATEMENT_DATA WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD

SELECT CASE WHEN OPERATING_REVENUE >= 10000000000 THEN 'SUPER_LARGE' WHEN OPERATING_REVENUE >= 1000000000 THEN 'LARGE' WHEN OPERATING_REVENUE >= 100000000 THEN 'MEDIUM' WHEN OPERATING_REVENUE >= 10000000 THEN 'SMALL' ELSE 'MICRO' END as revenueScale, COUNT(*) as count, AVG(OPERATING_REVENUE) as avgOperatingRevenue, AVG(NET_PROFIT_MARGIN) as avgNetProfitMargin, MAX(OPERATING_REVENUE) as maxOperatingRevenue, MIN(OPERATING_REVENUE) as minOperatingRevenue FROM INCOME_STATEMENT_DATA WHERE REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 GROUP BY CASE WHEN OPERATING_REVENUE >= 10000000000 THEN 'SUPER_LARGE' WHEN OPERATING_REVENUE >= 1000000000 THEN 'LARGE' WHEN OPERATING_REVENUE >= 100000000 THEN 'MEDIUM' WHEN OPERATING_REVENUE >= 10000000 THEN 'SMALL' ELSE 'MICRO' END ORDER BY avgOperatingRevenue DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN NET_PROFIT_MARGIN >= 15 THEN 'EXCELLENT' WHEN NET_PROFIT_MARGIN >= 10 THEN 'GOOD' WHEN NET_PROFIT_MARGIN >= 5 THEN 'NORMAL' WHEN NET_PROFIT_MARGIN >= 0 THEN 'POOR' ELSE 'LOSS' END as profitLevel, COUNT(*) as count, AVG(NET_PROFIT_MARGIN) as avgNetProfitMargin, AVG(OPERATING_REVENUE) as avgOperatingRevenue, AVG(NET_PROFIT) as avgNetProfit FROM INCOME_STATEMENT_DATA WHERE REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 GROUP BY CASE WHEN NET_PROFIT_MARGIN >= 15 THEN 'EXCELLENT' WHEN NET_PROFIT_MARGIN >= 10 THEN 'GOOD' WHEN NET_PROFIT_MARGIN >= 5 THEN 'NORMAL' WHEN NET_PROFIT_MARGIN >= 0 THEN 'POOR' ELSE 'LOSS' END ORDER BY avgNetProfitMargin DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN DATA_STATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN 1 END) as verifiedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN NET_PROFIT > 0 THEN 1 END) as profitableCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN NET_PROFIT < 0 THEN 1 END) as lossCount, AVG(OPERATING_REVENUE) as avgOperatingRevenue, AVG(NET_PROFIT) as avgNetProfit, AVG(NET_PROFIT_MARGIN) as avgNetProfitMargin, AVG(GROSS_PROFIT_MARGIN) as avgGrossProfitMargin, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as statisticsTime FROM INCOME_STATEMENT_DATA WHERE DELETED = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN DATA_STATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN 1 END) as verifiedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN NET_PROFIT > 0 THEN 1 END) as profitableCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN NET_PROFIT < 0 THEN 1 END) as lossCount, AVG(OPERATING_REVENUE) as avgOperatingRevenue, AVG(NET_PROFIT) as avgNetProfit, AVG(NET_PROFIT_MARGIN) as avgNetProfitMargin, AVG(GROSS_PROFIT_MARGIN) as avgGrossProfitMargin, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as statisticsTime FROM INCOME_STATEMENT_DATA WHERE DELETED = 0
mapper.update:
UPDATE INCOME_STATEMENT_DATA SET GROSS_PROFIT_MARGIN = CASE WHEN OPERATING_REVENUE > 0 THEN ROUND((OPERATING_REVENUE - OPERATING_COST) / OPERATING_REVENUE * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END, OPERATING_PROFIT_MARGIN = CASE WHEN OPERATING_REVENUE > 0 THEN ROUND(OPERATING_PROFIT / OPERATING_REVENUE * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END, NET_PROFIT_MARGIN = CASE WHEN OPERATING_REVENUE > 0 THEN ROUND(NET_PROFIT / OPERATING_REVENUE * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END, PERIOD_EXPENSE_RATIO = CASE WHEN OPERATING_REVENUE > 0 THEN ROUND((SELLING_EXPENSES + ADMINISTRATIVE_EXPENSES + RD_EXPENSES + FINANCIAL_EXPENSES) / OPERATING_REVENUE * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END, RD_EXPENSE_RATIO = CASE WHEN OPERATING_REVENUE > 0 THEN ROUND(RD_EXPENSES / OPERATING_REVENUE * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END, UPDATE_TIME =
NOW() SYSDATE
WHERE INCOME_STATEMENT_ID = #{incomeStatementId} AND DELETED = 0
